create_polar_projection_depth: create a PolarProjectionDepth module to project images into polar coordinates using depth scores and camera parameters
sample_depth_scores: sample depth scores from pixel scales and camera intrinsics using log-scale normalization and grid sampling
create_cartesian_projection: create a CartesianProjection module to convert polar-projected images into bird's eye view using camera parameters
grid_to_polar: convert a Cartesian grid to polar coordinates using camera focal length and principal point
sample_from_polar: sample a bird's eye view image from polar-projected data using normalized grid coordinates and validity masks
